findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is f310979ebfd4101919c30d42549dd3683bd6b4fb0f4533dded1396662aaf74ca; all 4 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The official plan PDF was retrieved at 971,223 bytes with SHA-256 c95d84641a0d024c04b9d8ba491e5972085b29a05a9aba4038128d78e8e12d01; it is unencrypted, has no JavaScript, and contains 75 physical pages.
Physical page 48 defines the industrial section as processing facilities and related personal property and places the work in an annual ad valorem appraisal program.

Physical page 49 says title and legal description are assumed, liens and encumbrances are disregarded, every property is not necessarily inspected each year, and sketches are visual aids rather than surveys or engineering reports unless otherwise specified.

Physical page 49 says the appraisals are exclusively for ad valorem tax purposes and limits representations about subsurface or hidden structural conditions unless specifically considered in an individual appraisal.
Current official Comptroller sources support only the bounded local-appraisal, January 1, mass-appraisal, and state-oversight context stated in the article.
